title: Starship Just Reached Orbit for the First Time
topic: Starship reaches orbit for the first time on Flight 14

title: The First Quantum Computer to Run in Space
topic: First quantum photonic processor operated in orbit (University of Vienna)

title: Figure Retired Its Old Robots… in Molten Steel
topic: Figure retires its F.02 humanoid robots by having them leap into molten steel (Finland)

title: Apple Pay Is Finally in India… But There's a Catch
topic: Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank (no UPI, no RuPay)

title: Nobel Prize 2026: Switching Brain Cells On and Off With Light
topic: Nobel Prize in Medicine 2026 for optogenetics (Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel)

title: Nobel Prize 2026: The Telescope Made of Antarctic Ice
topic: Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for IceCube and high-energy cosmic neutrinos (Francis Halzen)

title: Nvidia Just Built the Brain of a Windows Laptop
topic: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra pre-orders with Nvidia RTX Spark superchip (Oct 7 Windows & Surface event)

title: ChatGPT Just Stopped Answering With Only Text
topic: GPT-6 brings Intelligent UI to ChatGPT (interactive answers; paid Oct 7, Free & Go Oct 8)

title: Google's Gemini Agent Can Work on One Task for Days
topic: Google Cloud launches Gemini agent, a universal agent for work (Gemini at Work, Oct 8)

title: Tesla Just Dropped "Full Self-Driving" in Europe
topic: Tesla renames FSD (Supervised) to 'Tesla Assisted Driving' in Europe after Germany calls the name misleading

title: Being Cruel to Claude Is About to Break the Rules
topic: Anthropic updates Claude usage policy to bar sustained, needless cruelty toward its models (announced Oct 8, effective Nov 12)

title: Meta's Muse Wonder: 3 Things to Know About Its New AI
topic: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier-class models (Meta Superintelligence Labs, Oct 12)

title: Your Nose Can Smell a Molecule's Mirror Image
topic: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 for mirror-image molecules: non-linear effects and asymmetric autocatalysis (Henri Kagan, Kenso Soai); carvone spearmint vs caraway hook

title: This Mars Rover Just Broke an Out-of-This-World Driving Record
topic: NASA's Perseverance rover sets the off-world driving record (45.22 km / 28.10 mi on Oct 11, passing Opportunity; AutoNav >90%)

title: Amazon's New $75 AI Gadget Remembers What You Say
topic: Amazon launches Bee Frontier ($74.99 AI wearable, on sale Oct 15) and Bee Eclipse ($99.99 phone attachment, coming soon); Bee Pro $11.99/mo

title: Meta's Giant Open AI Runs on Just Two Macs
topic: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model (42B active, 1M context) optimized with Apple to run on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios (Oct 15)

title: Astronomers Just Found the First Green Star
topic: Astronomers identify the first known green star: white dwarf WD J1330+6435 tinted chartreuse by sodium from planetary debris (Warwick, RASTI, Oct 16); plus a pink carbon white dwarf, maybe the reddest star

title: Microsoft Just Walked Away From an AI Data Centre: No Power
topic: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's planned Loughton (Essex) AI data centre after UK Power Networks reportedly can't supply enough power until the early-to-mid 2030s (Telegraph Oct 18, Reuters Oct 19; 50 MW site, scalable to 90 MW)

title: One Hacker's AI Agents Broke Into 100+ Companies' Sites
topic: One hacker's AI agents attempted 1,200+ websites and reached sites at 100+ companies incl. John Deere, SharkNinja, Cummins (Reuters exclusive Oct 19; researcher Snorre Fagerland/NorForge via exposed Cairn panels; ~$50 of AI per break-in, rough estimate)

title: Nvidia's New Humanoid Robot: 3 Things to Know
topic: Nvidia and Agile Robots unveil Agile ONE SN reference humanoid at GTC Berlin (Oct 21): 1.40 m, WUJI Hand 2 hands with 20 DoF each + 1 kHz force control + touch, Isaac GR00T + Jetson Thor, setup weeks->days (Nvidia claim), 1,000-2,000 units planned (Agile CEO via Reuters), due early 2027

title: Claude's New AI Agent Messages You First
topic: Anthropic opens Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent, as a research preview (Oct 21): flags what needs attention from connected apps, morning briefing, keeps working in the cloud, asks before sending/paying/signing/deleting; US Pro & Max waitlist

title: AI Helped Find Critical PHP Flaws. Websites Went Offline to Patch
topic: PHP2Shell: two critical PHP flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619) found by Calif with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and independently by Wiz; PHP patches Oct 21; NSA: patch now or take sites offline; sites worldwide went offline to patch; PHP ~70% of sites with known server language (W3Techs)

title: Apple's First Folding iPhone: 3 Things to Know
topic: Apple iPhone Duo, first foldable iPhone, on sale Oct 23 ($1,999): 5.4-in outer / 7.6-in inner screens, 5.2 mm open, 254 g heaviest iPhone, Touch ID in side button replaces Face ID; preorders (Oct 16) sold out in ~30 min, new orders ship late Jan 2027

title: This Tiny Snake Escapes by Rolling Like a Wheel
topic: Dwarf reedsnakes (Pseudorabdion, Borneo) roll like wheels to escape: up to 3.69 m/s, ~4x top slithering speed; alternating left/right body strokes, steady forward-facing head, 20 cm track (Toho Univ., Current Biology, Oct 19; 13 snakes, 3 species)

title: NASA's Swift Telescope Is Falling Back to Earth
topic: NASA ends the Swift observatory's science mission ahead of re-entry (final observation Oct 20, announced Oct 23): launched 2004 for 2 yrs, ran ~22; >2,000 GRBs, >1,400 supernovae; solar-swollen atmosphere drag, no propulsion; Katalyst LINK rescue failed; re-entry within weeks; ~12 TB public archive

title: OpenAI's New AI Uses Your Computer, at Half the Price
topic: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra (Oct 26): computer use, visual reasoning, coding; API price 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra ($1/M input); +15 pts on professional computer tasks at ~1/3 cost (OpenAI); Terminal-Bench 4.0 50.3% vs 21.5%; Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu in ChatGPT & Codex + API

title: Apple's First Touchscreen MacBook Is Here
topic: Apple unveils its first touchscreen MacBook: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR (tandem OLED, up to 2,000 nits peak), Dynamic Island on Mac for the first time, M5 Pro/M5 Max, from $2,899 (+$400 vs non-touch), preorders Oct 28, available Nov 6

title: A New Dwarf Planet Beyond Pluto? Meet 2026 ED138
topic: Rubin Observatory's first dwarf planet candidate 2026 ED138 (MPC announced Oct 27; found by Matthew Holman Oct 13 in Rubin data since March): ~46 au, est. 600-1,500 km, ~280-yr orbit, near Milky Way plane; would join 5 IAU dwarf planets if confirmed
